tool.name: lookup_caller_work_en
tool.description: Record lookup: finds the record of the customer registered to this phone number. Use it when a caller who confirmed the name on the caller record asks when their next visit is. The result holds only this: known says whether a customer record was found, name is the name on the record, and upcoming_visits lists that customer's next visit days, earliest first, each with spoken, the day already written the way it is said aloud. You may tell that caller those days as spoken, as what the record shows; take a message for anything else. If the lookup fails or times out, say that the record could not be read just now and that the owner will confirm and call them back, and do not call the lookup again. If known is false, say that there is no record under this number and that the owner will confirm and call them back. If known is true and upcoming_visits is empty, say that the record shows no visit booked and that the owner will confirm and call them back. Once a lookup has answered, never say the record cannot be checked.
